data_policy: New 128-point/144Hz window [R-128,R+192) at360Hz, 533.33ms post-R waveform wait, segment normalization; same original subject roles and retained beat IDs; only incomplete longer context excluded and counted. Old test already known.
adaptation: Independent PyTorch implementations of published MF-CNN and residual Conv1D patterns. No author weights/code copied. Fixed raw input64 and causal3 RR from v1; learned convolutions, train-only BN; MF filters random initialization. Residual uses3 blocks/width16 or32 with causal RR head, not paper architecture/score reproduction.

gate.scope: Assistant proposed engineering target before v2 runs, not user/competition/clinical requirement. Same gate applies validation and old-test replay. Passing does not establish independent generalization, INT8, or FPGA readiness.

training.sampling: Natural TRAIN random permutation, no balanced sampling; TRAIN-only class-weighted CE
training.selection: Best validation macro-F1; tie lower validation cross entropy. Among candidates choose highest validation macro-F1. Do not load test tensors until all candidate selection is finished.
training.augmentation: Per-candidate augment flag controls train-only time/amplitude/noise perturbation
training.determinism: seed Python/NumPy/torch and deterministic CPU algorithms; fixed thread count; versions/hashes saved

test_policy: One replay for validation-selected model after whole suite; failure remains failure. Never select another candidate or retune using that replay.
rr_normalization: TRAIN mean/std floor0.01, standardized and clipped -5..5; no val/test fitting
design_reason: Proposed from class concentration and validation-only underfitting/generalization diagnosis; more P/T/context without changing subject roles or dropping F.
